English: Scroll Nook
A makeshift corner within the keep, lined with rough shelves and leather pouches to store essential scrolls and records. Offers modest support to administrative efforts.
Scriptorium
A covered structure with benches and ink-stained tables, where scribes labor to copy records and decrees. Improves local administration and levy organization.
Manuscript Room
A secure, dry chamber dedicated to housing valuable manuscripts. Skilled archivists preserve documents, supporting both taxation and military readiness.
Archive Chamber
A fortified stone room for storing sensitive records, decrees, and ledgers. Enhances administrative efficiency and defensive organization.
Keepers Vault
An imposing stone vault, attended by learned keepers, where the most vital records and secrets are guarded. Significantly improves tax collection and local fortification.
Wisemens Library
A dedicated hall of study and strategy, where wise men consult tomes and advise the lord. Greatly enhances levy organization and technological progress.
Royal Archive
A grand archive, staffed by officials, collecting royal decrees and ancestral records. Its influence streamlines castle governance and defense.
Scholars' Repository
An extensive collection curated by renowned scholars, with secure vaults and study rooms. Provides major improvements to governance, levy, and technological advancement.
Palace Archive
A sprawling archival complex within the palace, housing centuries of records, maps, and decrees. Empowers administration, levy, and technological superiority.
Grand Library
A legendary institution that houses ancient tomes, legal codes, and knowledge from distant lands. This crown jewel of administration empowers the realms prosperity, defense, and learning.
